item.description:
### Fixed - **Your phone's Live Activity catches up sooner after you answer on the Mac.** When an agent stopped needing you, the Live Activity on your iPhone could keep saying it did, because a quick run of updates was dropped instead of sent once things settled. Perch now sends the last update when the quiet period ends, and sends it at full priority when a wait has just ended.
### Added - **Groundwork for the next iPhone and Watch update.** Perch now tells your phone how many background tasks a Claude Code session has running, and when a "needs you" alert has been answered on the Mac so the phone can clear it. You'll see both once the matching iPhone app update is out.
